mechanism: Amphotericin B causes significant nephrotoxicity and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypomagnesemia) that impair duloxetine metabolism and increase risk of serotonin syndrome and cardiac arrhythmias.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and blood pressure closely; consider alternative antifungal if possible; ensure adequate hydration and electrolyte supplementation during concurrent use.
